decision_rationale: The record describes a Qwen3-4B model continued-pretrained with a standard next-token prediction objective, which is genuinely generative. It also shows foundation-model-like pretraining and transfer across RVQ-text, biomedical literature, and downstream tasks.
evidence_snippet: "all parameters ... are jointly optimized under a standard next-token prediction objective"; "Built on Qwen3-4B and trained via continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning"; "enabling bidirectional unification of cell interpretation and generation"; "ground the 256 newly introduced RVQ tokens"; "maps RVQ tokens to meaningful representations"; "not_assessed"; "not_assessed"; none; clear_include
